result.title: All Building Permits 2019-2024
result.snippet:
All building permits from 2019 - 2024 pulled from the Accela database. File contains all permit statuses - in review, issued, closed - so you can gauge pipeline vs. actual permits vs. actual construction. PLEASE CONSULT THE KEY IN THE DESCRIPTION FOR PERMIT STATUS EXPLANATION. This also contains the Zoning and the Land Use that came from GIS at the time of application. Lat/Long are included for easy mapping.

USE AT YOUR OWN RISK, THE CITY OF ATLANTA CANNOT ENSURE TOTAL ACCURACY OF THE DATA

result.serviceDescription: Issued/CO new construction SF + MF housing. 48% are within conservation areas

findings.observation: From August 3, 2020, reviews for new building-plan submissions appear under BB or LD. Earlier reviews stay under BA. Standalone BA includes DDH and appeals. Orange denotes submission and yellow denotes preliminary approval.
City page gives April 13, 2023 to December 31, 2025 and January 1, 2026 versions, selected by original submission to the Office of Buildings.
City dates pre-submission arborist meeting requirement to June 25, 2025 and provides open records routes.
Parks arborists handle public tree permits, street and park trees, and site plan reviews.
2021 Q3 City Planning tree activity report describes private property only and names Parks as the public-property record holder.
Section 158-109(1) distinguishes verbal approval with later application from qualifying after-hours removal, subsequent contact and documentation without a permit.
The commission hears and decides tree-related appeals. The indexed 2026 schedule has a decisions column. Historical decision coverage was not verified.
